item.title: 🔴 FGFM Authentication Weakening via CLI Configuration
item.description:
Why this matters: Authentication bypass — review access controls and look for unauthorized access.

CVSSv3 Score: 7.3

An Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel [CWE-288] vulnerability in FortiManager and FortiManager Cloud may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to impersonate any FortiGate managed by the FortiManager with a specific CLI option set via crafted FGFM requests if the attacker has a valid certificate.

Revised on 2026-08-12 00:00:00



Source: Fortinet PSIRT  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 37d

item.title: 🔴 LDAP authentication bypass in Agentless VPN and FSSO
item.description:
Why this matters: Authentication bypass — review access controls and look for unauthorized access.

CVSSv3 Score: 7.5

An Authentication Bypass by Primary Weakness vulnerability [CWE-305] in FortiOS fnbamd may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass LDAP authentication of Agentless VPN or FSSO policy, under specific LDAP server configuration.

item.title: 🟠 Pre-authentication Denial of Service attack in OpenSSH - CVE-2025-26466
item.description:
Why this matters: Could affect sign-ins, MFA, or Conditional Access — watch for authentication issues.

CVSSv3 Score: 5.9

CVE-2025-26466A flaw was found in the OpenSSH package. For each ping packet the SSH server receives, a pong packet is allocated in a memory buffer and stored in a queue of packages. It is only freed when the server/client key exchange has finished. A malicious client may keep sending such packages, leading to an uncontrolled increase in memory consumption on the server side. Consequently, the server may become unavailable, resulting in a denial of service attack.

Revised on 2026-05-25 00:00:00



Source: Fortinet PSIRT  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 556d
